football_evidence.question: Can Iowa’s pass rush get to Colton Joseph?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.5 points.
supporting: When Iowa has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Iowa’s offense has allowed a sack on 2.7% of its dropbacks, and Wisconsin’s defense sacks the quarterback on 5.8% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Iowa has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Iowa’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 13.8% of its runs, and Wisconsin’s defense stops 12.5% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).

When Wisconsin has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Wisconsin’s offense has allowed a sack on 4.5% of its dropbacks, and Iowa’s defense sacks the quarterback on 15.2% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Wisconsin has the ball (big plays on the ground): Wisconsin’s offense turns 4.8% of its runs into explosive gains, and Iowa’s defense gives up explosive gains on 2.6% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).
contradicting: When Iowa has the ball (big plays on the ground): Iowa’s offense turns 5.4% of its runs into explosive gains, and Wisconsin’s defense gives up explosive gains on 2.7% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).
When Iowa has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Iowa’s offense averages 7.1 yards per pass attempt, and Wisconsin’s defense allows 5.7 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).

When Iowa has the ball (big plays through the air): Iowa’s offense turns 8.9% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Wisconsin’s defense gives up explosive gains on 7.9% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When Wisconsin has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Wisconsin’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 11.6% of its runs, and Iowa’s defense stops 16.4% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
quarterbacks: Hank Brown has completed 89 of 145 passes (61.4%) for 986 yards, 6.8 yards per attempt, 6 touchdowns and 3 interceptions in six games for Iowa, and has been sacked on 5 of 150 dropbacks.
Jeremy Hecklinski has completed 39 of 65 passes (60.0%) for 447 yards, 6.9 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in five games for Iowa, and has been sacked on 1 of 66 dropbacks.
Colton Joseph has completed 97 of 171 passes (56.7%) for 1,250 yards, 7.3 yards per attempt, 10 touchdowns and 4 interceptions in seven games for Wisconsin, and has been sacked on 8 of 179 dropbacks.
